    Clock

    DigitalOutput

    Gpio
    GPIO operations recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    LedCanvas
    Pixel-addressing helpers for the UNO R4 WiFi's built-in 12x8 LED matrix.
    LedMatrix
    UNO R4 WiFi 12x8 built-in LED matrix operations recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
    LedMatrixFont
    A classic 5x7 dot-matrix font for digits and uppercase letters, sized to fit the UNO R4 WiFi's 12x8 LED matrix (two glyphs fit side by side: 5 + 1 gap + 5 = 11 of the 12 columns).
    LedMatrixFontAscii
    A 5x7 dot-matrix font covering the full printable ASCII range (32 space .. 126 ~), for printing arbitrary ASCII characters on the UNO R4 WiFi's 12x8 LED matrix one at a time (two glyphs fit side by side: 5 + 1 gap + 5 = 11 of the 12 columns).
    LedMatrixFontSmall
    A compact 3x5 dot-matrix font for digits 0-9, offered as a smaller alternative to the 5x7 LedMatrixFont (which it does not replace).
    LedMatrixShapes
    Draws rectangles (a square is just a rectangle with width == height), triangles, and circles into a LedMatrix.loadFrame(int, int, int) word, either filled solid or as a 1-pixel border outline.
    LedMatrixSmallText
    Draws LedMatrixFontSmall glyphs into a LedMatrix.loadFrame(int, int, int) word.
    LedMatrixText
    Draws LedMatrixFont and LedMatrixFontAscii glyphs into a LedMatrix.loadFrame(int, int, int) word.
    LedMatrixTransform
    Rotates the points of a LedMatrixShapes shape around a pivot before drawing it, using the standard 2D rotation matrix [[cos t, -sin t], [sin t, cos t]].
    Serial
    USB serial output recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.
